notes:
REF-BM-02: No remote metadata collection or favicon/preview-image fields.
REF-BM-03: Title and description are editable before and after saving, but they are never auto-collected.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but there is no separate note field.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are detected, but the dialog permits saving another copy instead of converging to editing the existing bookmark.
REF-BM-07: Cards expose title, description, and tags, but use a generated monogram rather than the site's favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain comma-separated input with no existing-tag autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and URL, but no note field exists.
REF-BM-14: The search implementation does not interpret #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search groups are not parsed.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are not parsed as exact matches.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state or action exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: No action marks a bookmark read.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: There is no whole-filtered-collection bulk action.
REF-BM-22: Results are always newest-first; users cannot choose a sort key.
REF-BM-23: There is no separate markdown note or markdown rendering.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML snapshot or PDF-download behavior exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot integration exists.
REF-BM-26: Bookmarks cannot be archived or hidden from default search/list views.
REF-BM-27: Permanent deletion exists, but no reversible archive state exists.
REF-BM-28: No archived-bookmarks view exists.
REF-BM-29: No saved-filter bundle model or interface exists.
REF-BM-30: No Netscape HTML import exists.
REF-BM-31: No Netscape HTML export exists.
REF-BM-32: No personal display-settings interface or persistence exists.
